CustomField.label: Passed Checks
CustomField.description: Controls how checks that Pass appear. "Show each passed check" lists every passed check. "Show passed count only" removes passed checks from the list; their count still appears in the summary. Defaults to "Show each passed check".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How passing checks appear. "Show each passed check" (default) = list them all. "Show passed count only" = hide from the list; the count still shows in the summary.
